shared_elements: low-relief carving on weathered pale stone
bird-like creature in profile with prominent head/beak
horizontal band of small repeated marks/notches
blank ground with no framing border
justification: Both show shallow, flush-cut relief on rough, weathered stone in which a profile bird/creature with a large rounded head is set against an empty ground beside a horizontal band of small repeated notches, which is the most specific correspondence. Otherwise they differ fundamentally: A is a tall vertical pillar with several stacked registers of flat, schematic, outline-like figures, while B is a single horizontal block with one larger, more rounded and modelled body whose surface detail (feather-like texturing) has no counterpart in A's linear idiom.
